location_description: Muskegon ( mus-KEE-gən or locally  mis-KEE-gən) is a city in the U.S. state of Michigan. It is the county seat of Muskegon County. Muskegon is known for fishing, sailing regattas, pleasure boating, and as a commercial and cruise ship port.
